implementation.admission: LazyColumnBundle discovers the installed v2 data-cache authority and uses current_read_budget as its shared residency ceiling. An explicit positive cap is clamped to the current shared ceiling; explicit zero, unknown authority, known-zero authority, and authority failures disable residency.
implementation.leases: An independently used bundle requests one SOURCE_READ broker lease per admitted physical Series. Lease IDs include a monotonic generation so a re-fetch can coexist with an older payload still owned by a caller.
implementation.owner_lifetime: The bundle reuses DataAccessSource._physical_cache_owners and installs weakref finalizers for the Series wrapper and distinct ndarray/index roots. Eviction, context invalidation, release_cached, and close remove residency references but do not release a lease while any physical owner remains alive.
implementation.source_single_owner: DataAccessSource constructs its LazyColumnBundle with materialized_budget=0. The bundle performs the governed collect but does not retain or charge the physical payload; DataAccessSource._put_cache is the sole resident-cache admission and lease owner. Repeated source requests therefore use the Source cache without another collect when admission succeeds, while a zero/denied budget intentionally permits re-read rather than ungoverned residency.
implementation.alias_and_request_integrity: The internal cache remains keyed by physical column name, logical aliases are applied only at the public return boundary, and request-owned strong references are captured before any eviction.

failure_cleanup.owner_discovery: If physical owners cannot be established, the payload is returned to the request but is not cached and no lease is requested.
failure_cleanup.lease_denial: If broker admission returns no lease, the payload remains request-only and no resident mapping is created.
failure_cleanup.finalizer_registration: If finalizer registration fails after lease acquisition, every already-created finalizer is detached, the tentative resident mapping and live-lease state are removed, and the acquired lease is released exactly once.

production_validation_boundary: The tests use bounded synthetic Polars/Pandas fixtures and fake shared brokers; no live production broker, COS dataset, or production factor publication was exercised.
The two same-named lazy-bundle mirror test modules must run in separate pytest processes because collecting both together triggers pytest's import-file-mismatch behavior.
No commit, push, deployment, dependency installation, or production data mutation was performed.
